review_candidates.description: تعلن شركة كيان للهندسه والتجاره عن حاجتها لتعيين مهندس كهرباء وإلكترونيات (حديث تخرج إلى خبرة متوسطة للعمل ضمن فريقها المتميز المسمى الوظيفي: مهندس كهرباء وإلكترونيات (تخصص أنظمة طاقة غير منقطعة UPS) مكان العمل : الجيزه الخبرة المطلوبة: من 1 إلى 3 سنوات في مجال أنظمة الـ UPS المهام والمسؤوليات: تركيب، تشغيل، وصيانة أنظمة الطاقة غير المنقطعة (UPS) بمختلف القدرات. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية والاختبارات الفنية لضمان كفاءة عمل الأجهزة. تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية والإلكترونية وإصلاحها بدقة وفي أسرع وقت. تقديم الدعم الفني والاستشارات للعملاء والإجابة على استفساراتهم التقنية. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية حول حالة الأنظمة والأعمال التي تم إنجازها. المؤهلات والشروط المطلوبة: بكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية أو هندسة الإلكترونيات. خبرة عملية مثبتة من سنة إلى 3 سنوات في التعامل المباشر مع أنظمة الـ UPS (صيانة، تركيب). معرفة قوية بالدوائر الإلكترونية، لوحات التحكم، والبطاريات الخاصة بأنظمة الطاقة. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتحليل الفني. مستوى جيد جدًا في اللغة الإنجليزية (قراءة الكتالوجات والتقارير الفنية). المميزات الوظيفية: راتب شهري مجزٍ يحدد حسب الخبرة. تأمين طبي واجتماعي. بيئة عمل احترافية وفرص حقيقية للتطور المهني. طريقة التقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية المحدثة إلى البريد الإلكتروني التالي: Hr@kianeg.com مع كتابة "(مهندس UPS)" في عنوان الرسالة

review_candidates.title: Printers maintenance engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description AbuElkher Distribution, founded in 1999, is a diversified technology distributor specializing in printers, inks, computer accessories, point of sale systems, security systems, and networking solutions. The company has pursued strategic global expansion and built strong market presence across multiple technology sectors. AbuElkher Distribution maintains alliances with leading international brands such as HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, ASUS, Intel, AMD, MSI, GIGABYTE, ACER, AOC, DELL, and CORSAIR. Team members benefit from exposure to a wide range of products and technologies, working in a dynamic environment that supports professional growth in technical and engineering roles. Role Description The Printers Maintenance Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Heliopolis. The individual in this position is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining a variety of printers and related equipment, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime for clients. Daily tasks include performing routine inspections, executing preventive maintenance plans, replacing parts, calibrating devices, and documenting all service activities in line with company standards. The role also involves responding to service requests, troubleshooting electrical and mechanical issues, and collaborating with sales and support teams to provide technical guidance on printer solutions. The engineer is expected to follow safety procedures, maintain organized workspaces, and keep current with new printer technologies and vendor specifications. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Equipment Maintenance and Maintenance Engineering, with hands-on experience working on printers and related hardware. Candidates should possess skills in Maintenance & Repair, including troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, and component replacement for mechanical and electronic printer systems. Candidates should possess skills in Preventive Maintenance, such as scheduling and executing routine checks, cleaning, calibration, and performance testing to reduce equipment failures. Candidates should possess skills in Electrical Maintenance, including safe handling of electrical components, reading basic circuit diagrams, and resolving electrical faults in printers. Relevant technical diploma or degree in electronics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to interpret manufacturer manuals, service documentation, and technical specifications for multiple printer brands. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently as well as within a team environment. Effective communication skills to explain technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and clients.

review_candidates.title: Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Design & Engineering - Review contract documents and project specifications to identify engineering requirements and scope of work. - Prepare preliminary and base design drawings, including:- Main Single Line Diagram (SLD) - Revenue Metering (R&M) SLD - Interlocking Philosophy and Schematics - DC System Diagrams - AC System Diagrams - Protection and Control Schematics - Perform design calculations for:- DC System Packages - AC Auxiliary Systems - CT Verification - VT Verification - Battery Sizing and Load Calculations - Prepare detailed engineering drawings for protection and control panels. - Develop panel wiring diagrams, terminal arrangements, cable schedules, and associated documentation. - Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM) for protection and control panels. - Develop LV control cables BOQs and cable schedules. Project Coordination - Coordinate with suppliers regarding technical submittals, drawings, and engineering requirements. - Follow up on engineering deliverables and vendor documentation. - Participate in technical meetings with suppliers, clients, and internal departments. - Coordinate with Supply Chain, Operations, and Project Teams to ensure timely delivery of engineering outputs. Testing & Commissioning Support - Attend Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and support the review of testing reports. - Assist in resolving technical issues identified during manufacturing, FAT, commissioning, or project execution phases. Documentation & Compliance - Ensure proper coding and document numbering in accordance with project and company procedures. - Maintain accurate engineering records and ensure timely submission of project deliverables. - Ensure designs comply with applicable standards, client specifications, and quality requirements.
